notes: Prop 13: assessed value increases limited to max 2%/yr (https://www.placer.ca.gov/5882/Proposition-13; also stated on the SmartAsset CA page). SmartAsset gives no data year for the 0.76% rate (CA statewide 0.71%). Zillow 'San Francisco, CA' metro = San Francisco-Oakland-Berkeley MSA; ZHVI $1,131,146 verified verbatim in the report table. A Kalshi market page (https://kalshi.com/markets/kxsfhomeval/san-francisco-typical-home-value-on-date/kxsfhomeval-26mar19) suggested the Feb 2026 SF metro typical value resolved above $1,265,000; it does not name its exact source, so the discrepancy is unresolved. Cross-checks: Apartment List Oct 2026 SF metro median rent $3,017, city $3,878 (https://www.apartmentlist.com/rent-report/ca/san-francisco); Redfin SF city median sale price $1,579,248 Sep 2026. Home-price index: FHFA purchase-only (replaced Case-Shiller/FHFA all-transactions on 2026-10-22).
